_help: Reviews. sheetCsvUrl = the 'Approved' tab of the reviews Google Sheet, published to the web as CSV (only approved rows are in it). formUrl + fields = the Google Form and its entry ids for the prefilled gallery/photo. manual = reviews typed in by hand (same shape: name, gallery, photo, text, stars, date YYYY-MM-DD). Changes here go live with the next push; Sheet approvals go live on their own within ~5 minutes.
